description: End-to-end workflow for managing telecom customer retention, including risk detection, offer design, simulation, approval, execution, monitoring, and recovery.

customer_id.description: Unique customer identifier in the CRM

retention_case_id.description: Identifier for a retention case opened for a customer

offer_id.description: Identifier of a retention offer template or instance

campaign_id.description: Identifier of a retention or win-back campaign

interaction_id.description: Identifier of a specific customer interaction (call, chat, store visit)

agent_id.description: Identifier of a human or virtual retention agent

criteria.description: Dynamic criteria used to define the segment

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: analyze_churn_risk
functions.description: Analyze churn risk for a customer or set of customers and open retention cases when thresholds are exceeded.

analysis_window_days.description: Number of past days to consider for usage and behavior.

thresholds.description: Churn thresholds to trigger retention cases.

min_risk_score.description: Minimum churn risk score to trigger a case.

min_arpu.description: Minimum ARPU to be eligible for retention actions.

include_low_value.description: Whether to include low-ARPU customers regardless of min_arpu.

open_retention_case.description: If true, automatically open retention cases for at-risk customers.

assigned_team.description: Team or queue to route cases to.

functions.returns: List of analyzed entities with churn risk scores and any newly created retention_case_ids.

functions.name: create_retention_case
functions.description: Explicitly create a retention case for a customer, linking churn signals and context.

preferred_resolution_window_hours.description: Target time to reach a resolution.

related_interaction_ids.description: Existing interaction IDs related to this case.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata key/values about the case.

functions.returns: Newly created retention_case_id and initial case status.

functions.name: get_retention_case
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a retention case.
functions.returns: Full retention case details including status, history, and any linked offers or interactions.

functions.name: list_retention_cases
functions.description: List and filter retention cases for monitoring and workload management.
functions.returns: Paginated list of retention cases matching the criteria with summary details.

functions.name: recommend_retention_offers
functions.description: Generate personalized retention offer recommendations for a case or customer.

retention_case_id.description: Recommended when designing offers within a case.

customer_id.description: Used when generating recommendations outside a case context.

constraints.description: Business and regulatory constraints for offer design.

regulatory_flags.description: Flags indicating special treatment (e.g., vulnerable customers).

explanations_required.description: Whether to include explainability for each recommendation.

functions.returns: Ranked list of recommended offers with predicted impact, eligibility checks, and optional explanations.

functions.name: simulate_retention_offer_impact
functions.description: Simulate commercial and churn impact of one or more retention offers before presenting to the customer.

offers.description: Candidate offers to simulate. Can reference templates or provide inline definitions.

offer_id.description: ID of an existing offer template or previously created offer.

inline_definition.description: Polymorphic inline offer definition if no offer_id is provided.

horizon_months.description: Forecast horizon to evaluate ARPU and churn impact.

discount_elasticity.description: Sensitivity of churn to price discounts.

functions.returns: Per-offer simulation results including predicted churn reduction, ARPU impact, NPV, and risk metrics.

functions.name: approve_and_lock_retention_offer
functions.description: Approve and lock a selected retention offer for a case, preparing it for presentation and execution.

offer_id.description: Offer to be approved and locked. May be a new instance created from a template.

constraints_validation.description: Optional override to re-validate constraints at approval time.

expiration.description: Controls how long the locked offer remains valid.

functions.returns: Confirmation of approved and locked offer with updated status and validity window.

functions.name: present_offer_to_customer
functions.description: Present a locked retention offer to the customer and capture their response.

interaction.description: Details of the interaction where the offer is presented.

customer_response.description: Optional immediate response if already known (e.g., synchronous interaction).

reason.description: Customer's stated reason for acceptance or rejection.

functions.returns: Offer presentation record with interaction_id linkage and current customer response status.

functions.name: apply_retention_offer
functions.description: Apply an accepted retention offer to the customer's account, updating plans, discounts, and commitments.

dry_run.description: If true, only validate and price the application without committing changes.

override_checks.description: Allow authorized users to override certain validations.

notify_customer.description: Notification preferences after applying the offer.

functions.returns: Execution result including applied changes, any provisioning orders created, and updated case status.

functions.name: get_retention_case_status
functions.description: Get current status, SLA, and key metrics of a retention case.
functions.returns: Current status, SLA countdown, and optional timeline and performance metrics for the retention case.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_retention_action
functions.description: Handle failed retention actions by retrying or rolling back applied offers and changes.

target.description: Specifies what to retry or rollback.

provisioning_order_id.description: ID of the underlying provisioning order if applicable.

step_name.description: Logical step in the retention workflow to address.

reason.description: Reason for retry or rollback request.

compensation_amount.description: Optional compensation amount if issuing credit.

functions.returns: Recovery plan and current execution status of retry or rollback actions.

functions.name: cancel_retention_case
functions.description: Cancel an open retention case and optionally revert or expire any associated offers.

offer_handling.description: How to handle any offers linked to the case.

functions.returns: Confirmation of case cancellation and final disposition of any associated offers.

functions.name: summarize_retention_performance
functions.description: Provide aggregated performance metrics for retention activities, campaigns, and segments.

include_breakdown_examples.description: If true, include a sample list of cases for each group for drill-down.

functions.returns: Aggregated KPIs such as save rate, incremental ARPU, discount costs, and churn reduction, optionally grouped by requested dimensions.

functions.name: retention_case_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import retention case entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: retention_case_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many retention case entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: retention_case_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many retention case entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: retention_case_bulk_export
functions.description: Export retention case entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: retention_case_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across retention case entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: retention_case_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for retention case events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: retention_case_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for retention case notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: retention_case_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more retention case entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: retention_case_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to retention case on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: retention_case_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a retention case operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: retention_case_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending retention case change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: retention_case_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending retention case approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: retention_case_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a retention case entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: retention_case_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a retention case entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: retention_case_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a retention case entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: retention_case_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a retention case entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: retention_case_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for retention case activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: retention_case_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a retention case view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: retention_case_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to retention case entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: retention_case_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given retention case payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: retention_case_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a retention case entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: retention_case_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a retention case entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
